verdict.rationale: Mercury's evidence pack documents a consolidated platform covering banking/accounts, cards & spend controls, bill pay/AI-read invoices, receipt capture, invoicing/AR, international payments, treasury yield, and accounting sync (QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite) all within one dashboard, and a 5-year real customer account (mercury-comm-1) confirms heavy real-world use replacing multiple functions (cards, accounts, wires, shared access). Missing for 10: independent third-party comparison confirming full replacement of dedicated point solutions (e.g., expense management, dedicated bill-pay software) and no case study explicitly framing 'consolidation' as a stated outcome/testimonial.
